adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` with an action `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({});` and does not attach any `.then/.catch` handling. On the server, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the serialized embedding object and performs no persistence. However, in the added `embedding.hbs` template there is no button or handler invoking `saveChanges` (the UI only adds/saves/deletes individual `embeddable-host` records), so the claimed “admin gets feedback / false sense that settings were saved” is not directly observable from this diff. Still, the update pathway as introduced is effectively a no-op and lacks error handling if it were to be used.
